snippet.title: Hue Factory - Gameplay Explainer
snippet.description:
Hue Factory is our upcoming minimalist automation game where color theory meets supply chain logic. In this video, our Creative Director, Elle, walks you through the core mechanics, from placing your first conveyor belt to mastering complex color mixing.

Wishlist Hue Factory on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4390180/Hue_Factory/ 

About the Game:
Hue Factory is a cozy but challenging experience designed for fans of factory builders like Shapez 2 and Infinifactory, as well as players who love the minimalist, high-stakes management of Mini Motorways or the peaceful puzzles of Dorfromantik.
